title: Deployment manifest
description: Pinned identity of one protocol deployment: its chain, contracts, ABI bundle, payment asset, timing bounds and canonicality invariant. Every plan, job, receipt and verification result carries the deploymentId defined here. WS01 owns the CONTENT of a manifest and must generate it from pinned deployment artifacts; this schema owns only its SHAPE. Addresses are never hand-copied from narrative documentation.

networkClass.description: Explicit. A mainnet manifest must have status disabled until a canonical production ENSv2 deployment exists (D-003).

protocol.description: ENSv1 exists here only so it can be selected as a separate explicit backend. It is never a silent fallback from ENSv2; detection fails closed.

status.description: Feature gate. A disabled manifest must be rejected before any wallet request is constructed.

artifactSource.description: Where the addresses and ABIs were imported from. Pinned so a manifest can be regenerated and diffed rather than trusted.

abiBundle.description: ABI set bound to this deployment. An unknown or mismatched bundle is refused rather than coerced (gap E2).

integrity.description: Subresource-integrity style digest over the serialized ABI bundle.

location.description: Path or package specifier the bundle is imported from.

canonicality.description: The fail-closed invariant (gap E1). Re-evaluated when a plan is built AND again immediately before any irreversible step, including on every resume.

argument.description: The argument passed to findCanonicalRegistry, as DNS-wire-encoded bytes, NOT a human label. For eth this is 0x0365746800. Stored pre-encoded so a consumer cannot disagree with the encoder about how a label becomes calldata.

argumentLabel.description: Human-readable label the argument encodes, for display and review only. Never used to build calldata.

failClosed.description: Not configurable. If the live result differs from expectedRegistry, execution aborts with E_DEPLOYMENT_DRIFT. There is no permissive mode and no fallback to ENSv1.

contracts.description: Role to contract mapping. The required roles below are the minimum a registration flow needs; additional roles may be added additively.

abiRef.description: Key into abiBundle. Never an inline ABI.

registrationPaymentAsset.description: ERC-20 the registrar charges in. Registration therefore needs both this asset and native gas (gap E4).

testFaucet.description: Optional test-token mint helper, testnet only.

commitment.description: Commit/reveal timing window enforced by the deployed registrar.

tokenModel.description: Canonical token semantics. ENSv2 uses an ERC-1155 singleton and its token IDs are MUTABLE: role grants and revocations can regenerate a token ID. This is the fact behind P-005 and gap I2/I4, so it is pinned in the manifest rather than assumed by each consumer.

stableIdentityKey.description: How a name is identified independently of its current token ID. Gate: P-005. Use resource. labelhash is listed because the registry accepts it as an anyId, but it is UNSAFE as an identity anchor: _entry() zeroes the version bits, so a labelhash anchor survives expiry and silently follows whoever re-registers the name, inheriting the previous holder's ERC-8004 identity. resource carries the EAC version counter in its low 32 bits, so it is invariant under token-ID regeneration and correctly dies on expiry, unregister and re-registration. See D-009.

adapter8004.description: Optional. Present only when identity binding is available on this deployment. The SOURCE version and the LIVE proxy implementation are separate facts and both are recorded, because a source release is not live until the Safe-owned UUPS proxy is upgraded (gap I3).

sourceReleased.description: False when the source version is unreleased upstream.

supportedTokenStandards.description: Binding standards the LIVE implementation supports, verified against deployed bytecode rather than the source release. Pinned here so every consumer does not re-derive it by probing.

supportsBindExisting.description: Whether bindExisting is present in the deployed bytecode. Source presence is not deployment presence.

getOwner.description: getOwner(uint256) is absent on older registries. When false, use ownerOf(getTokenId(anyId)), which is equivalent and present everywhere, so this is a capability flag rather than a hard gate.

registryHelpers.description: Which registry helper accessors exist on this deployment.

implementationSourceCommit.description: Source commit whose compiled output matches the live implementation's runtime bytecode. Matching bytecode to a commit is the only honest way to know what is deployed; a version string is a claim.

upgradeAuthority.description: Account that can upgrade the UUPS proxy. Recorded because it is the reason binding semantics can change between signing and execution.
